This directory contains the operational database modules used by the project.

## How modules are organized

Each module follows the same pattern:

- `SKILL.md` is the executable contract used by the system
- `README.md` is the human-facing overview
- the module owns one business process and one fixed field list

## Module structure

```text
skills/<slug>/SKILL.md     executable intake and output specification
skills/<slug>/README.md    readable explanation for humans
```

## Related docs

- [Root project README](../README.md)
- [References catalog](../references/catalog.md)
- [Tools overview](../tools/README.md)

## Notes

There are also pack-level routers such as:

- `skills/accounting-audit-system-builder/`
- `skills/brand-growth-system-builder/`

These route to a group of related modules while keeping the same overall contract.
